title: "I asked ChatGPT" is not a finding
description: "I asked ChatGPT what it really thinks" gets passed around as fact. Six incognito chats, six different biggest lies in human history, and why the format is what convinces people.

gallery.title: Slide 1: the question, "What is the biggest lie in human history?", framed as forbidden wisdom

Slide 3: two Claude chats answer Religion and "Forever", showing it is not a ChatGPT quirk
Slide 4: a Gemini chat answers Money. Six chats, six biggest lies in human history
